note: Snapshot of the certifying authorities registers, read 2026-09-08. This topic is NOT a consensus guide: the authorities publish the complete list themselves, so there is nothing a citation count can add. The article is built on these registers and scripts/verify-kosher-register.mjs checks its numbers against this file. Re-read the registers and update this snapshot rather than editing the article numbers by hand.

KLBD.name: Kashrut Division, London Beth Din
KLBD.trap: klbdkosher.org is the TRADE site and certifies manufacturers, not restaurants. Reading it alone yields the false conclusion that KLBD does not license restaurants at all.
KLBD.guarantees: All dairy restaurants use Chalav Yisrael; all meaty restaurants are Glatt.

KF.name: KF Kosher, Federation of Synagogues Beth Din
KF.note: A largely DIFFERENT set from KLBD. Reubens, Mazal, Soyo, Pita, One Ashbourne, Aviv, Pizaza, The Kanteen, Ranch, Bracha, Logans and Headroom Cafe are here and not on the KLBD register.

SKA.name: Sephardi Kashrut Authority
SKA.note: Smaller list including JW3 Cafe and Hendon Park Cafe. Guarantees Glatt, Chalav Yisrael and Yashan grain.

Kedassia.name: Union of Orthodox Hebrew Congregations
Kedassia.note: DNS does not resolve on apex or www, checked 2026-09-08. This is the authority most used in STAMFORD HILL, which is why the published registers show only one certified establishment there. The biggest hole in this topic - recheck periodically.
